body:
## A small good day

Got up when the alarm went instead of ten minutes later. **Actually went for the walk.** It was grey and I nearly didn't, but the river was quiet and my head was clearer afterwards.

- Drank water before coffee
- Read ten pages on the bus
- Called Mum

> Proud of: doing the walk when I didn't feel like it. That's the whole thing, really.
